title: Why Being Fat Destroys Your Relationship
hook: She won't tell you she's leaving because you got fat.
body:
Let's say you're in a relationship and you're getting a little overweight. Your partner might not consciously think, my husband's getting fat and sloppy, I'm going to divorce him. Instead she'll think, he just doesn't care about me like he used to. He isn't as funny as he used to be. The spark, the chemistry isn't there.

Those are the reasons that pop into her mind when she leaves you lonely. But a lot of the time the real reason is you got fat, you got lazy, and because of that she perceives all these negative traits in you.

So if your family and your relationship are your top priority, then you have to care about your health.
close: Leave a comment and tell me if you've seen this happen to a couple you know.
